subject: Leadership recap — outcomes, risk tolerances and procurement route
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@novamed.io>, procurement@novamed.io
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Leadership recap — outcomes, risk tolerances and procurement route

Tom / NovaMed team — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap from my side to make sure we’re aligned and to capture the asks you flagged for your execs: 

Summary of pain & goals (what we heard)
- Clinical decision support lagging: batch inference is adding 600–900ms to triage flows, pushing up patient handling time.
- Cost volatility on current endpoint spend; finance needs clearer pilot economics.
- Data residency & PHI controls: legal wants guarantees around logs, key management, and auditability.

Desired outcomes (measurable)
1) Reduce median latency for triage pipeline to under 200ms p95 for short-context calls.
2) Pilot economics: predictable burn under a $40k/month ceiling for 3-month pilot.
3) Compliance signs: SOC2 evidence + audit log export and KMS integration in place before pilot go-live.

Risks called out by NovaMed leadership
- Procurement inertia if legal requests bespoke controls (timeline slip).
- If on-hosted only, risk of PHI residency mismatch — prefer private deployment or VPC.

Recommended procurement route (based on what we discussed)
- Short pilot SOW + reserved Dedicated capacity (monthly commit) to lock unit economics and latency.
- Legal review limited to SOC2 artifact + binding data-residency appendix; avoid long custom T&Cs in first iteration.
- Parallel technical POC: private deployment that demonstrates residency + perf at small scale.

Open asks / next steps (owners & ETA)
1) NovaMed to confirm data-residency requirement (region + any air-gapped needs) — owner: Tom / Procurement — due: 2026-12-11.
2) Redwood to deliver one-page exec brief for CFO and a 1-week pilot cost estimate — owner: Kimberly / Karthik — due: 2026-12-10.
3) Legal evidence pack (SOC2 snapshot + KMS integration note) attached for review.
4) Schedule a stakeholder alignment (CFO + Head of Infra + Legal) — propose 30-min slot next week.

Attachments: MutualActionPlan.xlsx (xlsm) — draft MMP with milestones; SOC2-snapshot.pdf (pdf) — control map excerpt.

If I missed anything important from the call, say so and I’ll update. If the list looks right, Tom — can you confirm the procurement contact and preferred next-meeting windows?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference
From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@novamed.io>

Cc: procurement@novamed.io, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Leadership recap — outcomes, risk tolerances and procurement route

Kimberly — appreciate the concise recap. A couple clarifications from our side: 

1) Data residency: must keep PHI within our US-only cloud tenancy for the pilot. No cross-region replication.
2) Compliance: SOC2 is necessary but not sufficient for some of our auditors — they’ll ask for an exportable audit log and an option to ship logs to our Kinesis/Splunk.
3) Budget: CFO asked for a ballpark monthly number before we surface this to procurement — can you give a not-to-exceed pilot estimate?

I’ll confirm internal stakeholders formally (CFO: Lydia Park; Head of Infra: Marcus Chen; Legal contact: procurement@novamed.io). We’re available for a 30-min alignment on 2026-12-15 or 12-16 mornings PST.

—Tom
Tom Nguyen
Director, Product & Technology | NovaMed Health
tom.nguyen@novamed.io | (415) 555-6543
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@novamed.io>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novamed.io
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Leadership recap — outcomes, risk tolerances and procurement route

Thanks, Tom — short answers and concrete items so your CFO/legal team have something to react to:

- Residency & logs: We can deploy Redwood Private in your US tenancy for the pilot (no cross-region replication). Audit logs + structured exports to your Kinesis/Splunk are supported; will provide integration notes.

- Performance: For the triage flow you described, we recommend Dedicated capacity with a small pool (2 x A100-equivalent) to meet p95 < 200ms for short-context calls with continuous batching disabled for those low-latency routes. We’ll include a fallback hosted model to keep SLAs if private nodes are degraded.

- Ballpark pilot economics (3-month pilot, reserved capacity + limited API ingress): est. $28k–$36k/month depending on inference mix. Up-front: one-time onboarding/ops engineering fee (est. $10k). We’ll produce a line-item PDF. (See attachment: pilot-cost-estimate.pdf)

- Legal/compliance artifacts: attached SOC2 snapshot; we’ll also prepare an appendix draft for data-residency & log export in the MMP so legal has language to review.

Next steps I’ll own: deliver a one-page executive brief + line-item pilot estimate by EOD 2026-12-10 and a draft MMP clause for data residency by 2026-12-11.

On quoting Tom’s availability — 12/15 morning PST works for us.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference

Karthik — perfect, that range helps. Two quick asks before our CFO meeting:
1) Can you add a single slide that ties the pilot outcomes to a 12-month ROI projection (ops savings + throughput improvement)?
2) We’ll circulate an invite for 12/15 9:30am PST — please confirm if execs (Lydia Park, Marcus Chen) can join; otherwise we’ll do a short working-level alignment first.

I’ll confirm attendees and send the calendar. Thanks for the timing on deliverables.

—Tom

2) Pilot cost estimate (attached: pilot-cost-estimate.pdf).
3) Draft MMP data-residency appendix added to the shared MutualActionPlan.xlsx; uploaded MMP and SOC2 snapshot to the HubSpot deal and legal drive (link below).
4) DocuSign: I’ve prepared a short mutual-action-plan signature page to formalize the pilot milestones and timeline. If that’s acceptable, please sign here: https://docusign.com/link/ABCDEF123456

Proposed next meeting: 2026-12-15 09:30 PST — Kimberly, Karthik and Marissa will join for the exec alignment if Lydia/Marcus are available; otherwise we’ll proceed with working-level.

Thanks — look forward to the confirmation.
